name: kernel_norm_le_two
code:
/-- P0082 page 357 display 4. The explicit kernel is uniformly bounded by two.
This supplies a fixed constant for the nearby strip estimate on page 366. -/
theorem kernel_norm_le_two {Δ : ℝ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) (hΔ1 : Δ < 1) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖(Kfun Δ x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 2 := by
  let K : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => (Kfun Δ y : ℂ)
  have hki : Integrable K := KernelTransform264.Kfun_integrable hΔ hΔ1
  have hfi : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier K) :=
    Decomp450j.bandlimited_fourier_integrable K hki (by
      intro ξ hξ
      exact KernelTransform264.ftR_Kfun_zero hΔ hΔ1 hξ.le)
  have hinv : FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (FourierTransform.fourier K) x = K x :=
    hki.fourierInv_fourier_eq hfi (KernelTransform264.Kfun_continuous Δ).continuousAt
  have hzero (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : ξ ∉ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
      ‖FourierTransform.fourier K ξ‖ = 0 := by
    have hh : 1 < |ξ| := by
      by_contra! hle
      exact hξ (abs_le.mp hle)
    change ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun y : ℝ => (Kfun Δ y : ℂ)) ξ‖ = 0
    rw [KernelTransform264.fourier_Kfun hΔ hΔ1,
      KernelTransform264.weight_zero hΔ hΔ1 hh.le, Complex.ofReal_zero, norm_zero]
  have hbound (ξ : ℝ) : ‖FourierTransform.fourier K ξ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    change ‖FourierTransform.fourier (fun y : ℝ => (Kfun Δ y : ℂ)) ξ‖ ≤ 1
    rw [KernelTransform264.fourier_Kfun hΔ hΔ1, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (KernelTransform264.weight_bounds hΔ hΔ1 ξ).1]
    exact (KernelTransform264.weight_bounds hΔ hΔ1 ξ).2
  change ‖K x‖ ≤ 2
  calc
    ‖K x‖ = ‖FourierTransform.fourier (FourierTransform.fourier K) (-x)‖ := by
      rw [← hinv, Real.fourierInv_eq_fourier_neg]
    _ ≤ ∫ ξ, ‖FourierTransform.fourier K ξ‖ := Real.norm_fourier_le_integral_norm _ _
    _ = ∫ ξ in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ‖FourierTransform.fourier K ξ‖ :=
      (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ ξ in Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, (1 : ℝ) :=
      setIntegral_mono_of_nonneg (fun ξ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun ξ _ => hbound ξ)
        continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc
    _ = 2 := by norm_num [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, Real.volume_real_Icc]
twin: For zero less than Delta less than one, the complex norm of the explicit paper kernel at every real point is at most two. This is the bounded part of display 4 with an explicit constant.
instance: At Delta 1/8 and x zero, the norm is 15/8, which is at most two.
source: P0082 page 357 display 4, derived from the page 356 trapezoid weight and Fourier inversion.

name: leaf_localization
code:
/-- P0082 page 366 display 27. Exact nearby strip localization.
The explicit prime sum bound hsup remains a hypothesis. -/
theorem leaf_localization (γ δ κ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : ℝ)
    (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hΔ : calE γ κ N ^ (-(1 / 8 : ℝ)) < 1)
    (hsup : ∀ β ∈ truncatedDomain (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N),
      ‖Sp (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N) β‖ ^ 2 ≤ U) :
    nearMoment γ δ κ N ≤
      4 * N * F γ N ^ (3 * δ - 1) * U *
        (∫ α in truncatedDomain (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N),
          ‖Sp (F γ N ^ (6 * δ)) (F γ N) α ^ 2 *
            (Kfun (calE γ κ N ^ (-(1 / 8 : ℝ))) α : ℂ)‖) := by
  let X := F γ N
  let P := X ^ (6 * δ)
  let Δ := calE γ κ N ^ (-(1 / 8 : ℝ))
  let r := X ^ (3 * δ - 1)
  let A := truncatedDomain P X
  let w : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖Sp P X x ^ 2 * (Kfun Δ x : ℂ)‖
  have hw (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ w x := norm_nonneg _
  have hr : 0 < r := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _
  have hΔ0 : 0 < Δ := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _) _
  have hsp : Continuous (Sp P X) := by unfold Sp eC; fun_prop
  have hc : Continuous w :=
    ((hsp.pow 2).mul (KernelTransform264.Kfun_continuous Δ)).norm
  have hi : IntegrableOn w A := hc.integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Set.inter_subset_right
  have hwb (β : ℝ) (hβ : β ∈ A) : w β ≤ 2 * U := by
    have hK := kernel_norm_le_two hΔ0 hΔ β
    have hS := hsup β hβ
    dsimp only [w]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
    calc
      ‖Sp P X β‖ ^ 2 * ‖(Kfun Δ β : ℂ)‖ ≤ U * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul hS hK (norm_nonneg _) hU
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hinner (α : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ A) :
      (∫ β in A ∩ {β : ℝ | |α - β| ≤ r},
        w α * w β * ‖phaseSum γ N (β - α)‖) ≤
        (4 * N * r * U) * w α := by
    have hsub : A ∩ {β : ℝ | |α - β| ≤ r} ⊆ Set.Icc (α - r) (α + r) := by
      intro β hβ
      have hh := abs_le.mp hβ.2
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hiC : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => w α * (2 * U) * N)
        (Set.Icc (α - r) (α + r)) := continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ β in A ∩ {β : ℝ | |α - β| ≤ r}, w α * (2 * U) * N := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_of_nonneg
        · intro β hβ
          exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw α) (hw β)) (norm_nonneg _)
        · intro β hβ
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hwb β hβ.1) (hw α))
            (Decomp428d.phaseSum_norm_le γ N (β - α)) (norm_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg (hw α) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hU))
        · exact hiC.mono_set hsub
      _ ≤ ∫ β in Set.Icc (α - r) (α + r), w α * (2 * U) * N :=
        setIntegral_mono_set hiC
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ =>
            mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw α) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hU))
              (Nat.cast_nonneg N))) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hsub)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [setIntegral_const, Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith), smul_eq_mul]
        ring
  change (∫ α in A, ∫ β in A ∩ {β : ℝ | |α - β| ≤ r},
      w α * w β * ‖phaseSum γ N (β - α)‖) ≤
    4 * N * r * U * (∫ α in A, w α)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ α in A, (4 * N * r * U) * w α := by
      apply setIntegral_mono_of_nonneg
      · intro α hα
        exact integral_nonneg (fun β =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw α) (hw β)) (norm_nonneg _))
      · exact hinner
      · exact hi.const_mul _
    _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _
twin: If the squared prime sum norm is at most a nonnegative U throughout the truncated minor domain, the nearby moment is bounded by four times N times the strip radius times U times the weighted energy.
instance: Take gamma 5/4, delta 1/100, kappa one and N 16. A finite sum of absolute log weights squared supplies a valid U. The strip radius is positive and Delta is less than one.
source: P0082 page 366 display 27. The explicit hsup bound remains a hypothesis.
status: CONDITIONAL ON the explicit prime sum bound hsup
